meta.title: CoinW Agent Skill · MVP Roadmap
meta.description: Turn an Agent into the trading brain of every CoinW user — from reading the market to placing orders in one sentence. Nine steps from v1.0 to v2.0, all on the table.

hero.title: Make AI Trading for Every Trader
hero.subtitle: Not a charting tool. Not a copy-trade bot. AI reads the market, picks strategies, and executes — one click, zero code.

act1.title: Runs
act1.desc: Version one doesn't need to be smart. It needs to work end to end. Read the market, place an order, check a position — the Agent treats the exchange like an API.

act2.title: Contained
act2.desc: Put the Agent in a sandbox. Multi-wallet, risk controls, alerts, a low-friction entry — it can't run wild, and it can't lose the user's money.

act3.title: Grows
act3.desc: The Agent picks its own Skills, writes its own strategies, grades its own results. v1.5 is the Agent Zone. v2.0 merges back into the main site. The end state: a trading brain that evolves.

v10.headline: The exchange becomes the Agent's raw material
v10.lede: One command to connect. One sentence to trigger. Agents call exchange capabilities directly — market data, orders, positions.

market.title: Live Market Data
market.subtitle: What the Agent sees, you see too

whatIs.title: What are Agent Skills
whatIs.desc: A set of exchange capabilities exposed to AI Agents. Your Agent uses them to read markets, place orders, check positions, and manage risk — no API wiring, no code.
whatIs.note: Skills are not the Agent. They're its hands and eyes — the Agent thinks, Skills do the work.

items.title: Zero barrier, one click to go
items.desc: No Agent framework needed, no code, no config. One command to install, ready to use.

items.title: Personalized, learns your style
items.desc: Remembers your preferences, risk level, trading style. Reports, strategies, alerts — all tailored, no generic templates.

items.title: Hardened security, never tests with your money
items.desc: Four-tier permissions, per-trade and daily caps, large-trade confirmation, withdrawal lockdown. Every feature tested in isolation before going live.

v11.headline: One sentence, end to end
v11.lede: Type a sentence, the Agent calls the right Skills, results stream back in real time. Three core paths — check the market, place a limit order, discover and connect Skills — all walkable.

v12.headline: One user, several wallets
v12.lede: Spot, futures, staking — the Agent knows which wallet you mean. Four permission tiers: read, spot, futures, full. Out-of-scope calls get refused instantly.
bullets: Wallet-aware · the Agent reads your fund layout
Four-tier permissions · least privilege, not all-or-nothing
Out-of-scope block · wrong wallet, wrong call — platform says no
User-visible trace · every call logs which tier it went through

v13.headline: Large trades require your confirmation
v13.lede: Above the threshold you set, the Agent stops and asks. Push via App, TG, or Email. No response? Default to reject.
bullets: Configurable threshold · by dollar or by position %
Timeout policy · if you don't answer, default (reject or hold)
Full audit trail · every confirmation chain logged

v14.headline: No Agent? Just type in TG.
v14.lede: TG bot command or email subscription — same Skills, same results. Zero config, sign up and go.
bullets: TG bot · one line equals a full Agent call
Email subscription · digest / alerts / portfolio to inbox
Same source · identical Skills, matching results
Zero setup · no install, no config, sign up and go

v15.headline: Agents pick their own Skills and build their own plays
v15.lede: 14+ capability modules on the Skill Marketplace. Agents load on demand, compose strategies, run backtests. The central node shows mount status in real time.
